Backups.description: Details of each backup stored by Barman for this server keyed by Backup ID.

backup_id.description: The backup ID of the backup

backup_label.description: The backup label generated by PostgreSQL

begin_offset.description: The byte offset of the current WAL at the start of the backup

begin_time.description: The system time of the Barman server at the start of the backup (in ISO 8601 in the local timezone of the server)

begin_wal.description: The current WAL segment at the start of the backup

begin_xlog.description: The LSN of the PostgreSQL server at the start of the backup

compression.description: The type of compression used to compress the backup

config_file.description: The path to the `postgresql.conf` file of the PostgreSQL server when the backup was taken

deduplicated_size.description: The size of the backup in bytes accounting for any hard links to files in previous backups

end_offset.description: The byte offset of the current WAL at the end of the backup

end_time.description: The system time of the Barman server at the end of the backup (in ISO 8601 in the local timezone of the server)

end_wal.description: The current WAL segment at the end of the backup

end_xlog.description: The LSN of the PostgreSQL server at the end of the backup

hba_file.description: The path to the `pg_hba.conf` file of the PostgreSQL server at the time the backup was taken

ident_file.description: The path to the `pg_ident.conf` file of the PostgreSQL server at the time the backup was taken

included_files.description: All files referenced by include directives in the PostgreSQL config which were included in the backup

items.description: Path to an included config file

mode.description: The combined `backup_method` and `backup_options` configured for the server at the time of the backup - can be one of: `local-rsync-concurrent`, `local-rsync-exclusive`, `postgres-concurrent`, `postgres-exclusive`, `rsync-concurrent` or `rsync-exclusive`

pgdata.description: The path to the PGDATA directory of the PostgreSQL server at the time the backup was taken

server_name.description: The name of this server as configured in Barman

size.description: The size of the backup in bytes

status.description: The current status of the backup

systemid.description: The system identifier of the PostgreSQL server from which the backup was taken

tablespaces.description: The tablespaces included in this backup

timeline.description: The timeline of the PostgreSQL server when the backup was taken

version.description: The version of the PostgreSQL server

xlog_segment_size.description: The WAL segment size in bytes as reported by the PostgreSQL server when the backup was taken

archiver.description: Whether Barman should check for and manage WALs archived to Barman via PostgreSQL WAL archiving

archiver_batch_size.description: The maximum number of WAL files to be archived by Barman in a single run

backup_compression.description: The type of compression to be applied during the backup process (only supported when backup_method = postgres)

backup_compression_format.description: The format for the backup output - this can be either "plain" or "tar" (only supported when backup_method = postgres)

backup_compression_level.description: The compression level to be applied when compressing the backup (only supported when backup_method = postgres)

backup_compression_location.description: This can be set to either "server" or "client" depending on where the compression should be performed (only supported when backup_method = postgres)

backup_method.description: The method used by Barman for backup execution - one of: local-rsync, postgres or rsync

backup_options.description: A comma-separated list of options - either: `exclusive_backup` or `concurrent_backup` and optionally: `external_configuration`

bandwidth_limit.description: Maximum transfer rate in kilobytes per second

basebackup_retry_sleep.description: Number of seconds of wait after a failed copy, before retrying

basebackup_retry_times.description: Number of retries of base backup copy, after an error

check_timeout.description: Maximum execution time, in seconds per server, for a barman check

compression.description: Standard compression algorithm applied to WAL files

configuration_files_directory.description: Directory for additional configuration files to be included

create_slot.description: Whether Barman should automatically create the replication slot - one of `auto` or `manual`

custom_compression_filter.description: Customised compression algorithm applied to WAL files

custom_compression_magic.description: Customised compression magic which is checked in the beginning of a WAL file to select the custom algorithm

custom_decompression_filter.description: Customised decompression algorithm applied to compressed WAL files

forward_config_path.description: Determines whether a passive node should forward its configuration file path to its primary node during cron or sync-info commands

immediate_checkpoint.description: Whether to request an immediate checkpoint at the start of a backup

last_backup_maximum_age.description: A time frame that must contain the latest backup

last_backup_minimum_size.description: The lower limit to the acceptable size of the latest successful backup

last_wal_maximum_age.description: A time frame that must contain the latest WAL file archive

max_incoming_wals_queue.description: Maximum number of WAL files in the incoming queue that are allowed before barman check returns an error

minimum_redundancy.description: Minimum number of backups to be retained

network_compression.description: Enable data compression for network transfers

parallel_jobs.description: How many parallel workers will copy files during a backup or recovery command

path_prefix.description: One or more absolute paths, separated by colon, where Barman looks for executable files

post_archive_retry_script.description: Hook script launched after a WAL file is archived by maintenance

post_archive_script.description: Hook script launched after a WAL file is archived by maintenance, after `post_archive_retry_script`

post_backup_retry_script.description: Hook script launched after a base backup

post_backup_script.description: Hook script launched after a base backup, after `post_backup_retry_script`

post_delete_retry_script.description: Hook script launched after the deletion of a backup

post_delete_script.description: Hook script launched after the deletion of a backup, after `post_delete_retry_script`

post_recovery_retry_script.description: Hook script launched after a recovery

post_recovery_script.description: Hook script launched after a recovery, after `post_recovery_retry_script`

post_wal_delete_retry_script.description: Hook script launched after the deletion of a WAL file

post_wal_delete_script.description: Hook script launched after the deletion of a WAL file, after post_wal_delete_retry_script`

pre_archive_retry_script.description: Hook script launched before a WAL file is archived by maintenance, after `pre_archive_script`

pre_archive_script.description: Hook script launched before a WAL file is archived by maintenance

pre_backup_retry_script.description: Hook script launched before a base backup, after `pre_backup_script`

pre_backup_script.description: Hook script launched before a base backup

pre_delete_retry_script.description: Hook script launched before the deletion of a backup, after `pre_delete_script`

pre_delete_script.description: Hook script launched before the deletion of a backup

pre_recovery_retry_script.description: Hook script launched before a recovery, after `pre_recovery_script`

pre_recovery_script.description: Hook script launched before a recovery

pre_wal_delete_retry_script.description: Hook script launched before the deletion of a WAL file, after `pre_wal_delete_script`

pre_wal_delete_script.description: Hook script launched before the deletion of a WAL file

primary_ssh_command.description: Command used by a passive Barman server to login to the primary Barman server via ssh

recovery_staging_path.description: Path on the recovery host where compressed backups can be temporarily staged during recovery

retention_policy.description: Policy for retention of periodic backups and archive logs

retention_policy_mode.description: Mode which defines how retention policies are applied

reuse_backup.description: Defines how incremental backup should be applied - one of `copy`, `link` or `off`

slot_name.description: Physical replication slot to be used by the `receive-wal` command

streaming_archiver.description: Whether to use PostgreSQL's streaming protocol to receive transaction logs from a server

streaming_archiver_batch_size.description: The maximum number of streamed WAL files to be archived by Barman in a single run

streaming_archiver_name.description: Identifier to be used as `application_name` by the `receive-wal` command

streaming_backup_name.description: Identifier to be used as `application_name` by the `pg_basebackup` command

tablespace_bandwidth_limit.description: Maximum transfer rate in kilobytes per second when copying a specific tablespace - specified as a comma separated list of TABLESPACE:BWLIMIT pairs

wal_retention_policy.description: Policy for retention of archive logs (WAL files)

analysis_time.description: Total number of seconds spent in the analysis phase during this backup

analysis_time_per_item.description: Number of seconds spent in the analysis phase for each item, where an item can be the PGDATA directory or a tablespace directory

pgdata.description: Number of seconds spent in the analysis phase for PGDATA

TABLESPACE.description: Number of seconds spent in the analysis phase for TABLESPACE

copy_time.description: Total wall-clock time spent in the copy phase during this backup in seconds

copy_time_per_item.description: Wall-clock time spent copying each item in seconds - an item can be the PGDATA directory, a tablespace directory, the pg_control file or any configuration files located outside the PGDATA directory

pgdata.description: Number of wall-clock seconds spent in the copy phase for PGDATA

TABLESPACE.description: Number of wall-clock seconds spent in the copy phase for TABLESPACE

FILENAME.description: Number of wall-clock seconds spent in the copy phase for FILENAME

number_of_workers.description: Number of workers used to copy files in the backup

serialized_copy_time.description: Total time spent copying data across all copy jobs in seconds

serialized_copy_time_per_item.description: Total time spent copying each item across all copy jobs in seconds - an item can be the PGDATA directory, a tablespace directory, the pg_control file or any configuration files located outside the PGDATA directory

pgdata.description: Total number of seconds spent by all copy jobs copying the data for PGDATA

TABLESPACE.description: Total number of seconds spent by all copy jobs copying the data for TABLESPACE

FILENAME.description: Total number of seconds spent by all copy jobs copying the data for FILENAME

total_time.description: Total wall-clock time spent taking the backup in seconds

errors_list.description: List of configuration errors affecting multiple servers

items.description: An error detected for a combination of servers while parsing the config

log_level.description: Level of logging (DEBUG, INFO, WARNING, ERROR, CRITICAL)

compression.description: Compression algorithm used to compress the WAL

size.description: Size in bytes of the WAL stored on the Barman server

time.description: Timestamp in epoch time format representing the time this WAL was archived by Barman

ReplicationSlot.description: Details of the replication slot being used by Barman on this PostgreSQL server in the form of an ordered array. The first item MUST be a string containing the slot_name. The second item MUST be a boolean reflecting the active state of the replication slot. The third item MUST be a string containing the LSN of the oldest WAL which still might be required by the consumer of this slot.

active.description: Whether the server is configured as active

backup_directory.description: Directory where backup data for a server will be placed

basebackups_directory.description: Directory where base backups will be placed

conninfo.description: Connection string used by Barman to connect to the PostgreSQL server

description.description: A human readable description of a server

disabled.description: Whether the server has been disabled due to configuration errors

errors_directory.description: Directory that contains WAL files that contain an error

incoming_wals_directory.description: Directory where incoming WAL files are archived

msg_list.description: List of configuration errors for this server

items.description: An error detected for this server while parsing the config

name.description: The name of this server as configured in Barman

primary_conninfo.description: Connection string used by Barman to connect to the primary PostgreSQL server server when conninfo is pointing to a standby

ssh_command.description: Command used by Barman to login to the PostgreSQL server via ssh

streaming_conninfo.description: Connection string used by Barman to connect to the PostgreSQL server via streaming replication protocol

streaming_wals_directory.description: Directory where WAL files are streamed from the PostgreSQL server to Barman

Status.description: Status information about the PostgreSQL server

archive_command.description: The current value of archive_command on the PostgreSQL server

archive_mode.description: The current value of archive_mode on the PostgreSQL server

archive_timeout.description: The current value of archive_timeout (in seconds) on the PostgreSQL server

archived_count.description: The number of WAL files that have been successfully archived by the PostgreSQL server

checkpoint_timeout.description: The current value of checkpoint_timeout (in seconds) on the PostgreSQL server

config_file.description: The current path to the `postgresql.conf` file of the PostgreSQL server

connection_error.description: Error message in the event that barman cannot connect to the PostgreSQL server

current_archived_wals_per_second.description: The WAL archive rate of the PostgreSQL server calculated over the time since the last stats reset

current_lsn.description: The current LSN of the PostgreSQL server

current_size.description: The total size of the PostgreSQL server in bytes

current_xlog.description: The current WAL of the PostgreSQL server

data_checksums.description: Whether data checksums are enabled for the PostgreSQL server - can be either `on` or `off`

data_directory.description: The current path to the PGDATA directory of the PostgreSQL server

failed_count.description: The number of failed attempts for archiving WAL files by the PostgreSQL server

has_backup_privileges.description: Whether the configured user has the PostgreSQL privileges required in order to take a backup

hba_file.description: The current path to the `pg_hba.conf` file of the PostgreSQL server

hot_standby.description: The current value of hot_standby on the PostgreSQL server

ident_file.description: The current path to the `pg_ident.conf` file of the PostgreSQL server

is_archiving.description: Whether the PostgreSQL server is currently archiving WALs (as determined by Barman from the content of `pg_stat_archiver`)

is_in_recovery.description: Whether the PostgreSQL server is currently in recovery (as determined by Barman using `pg_is_in_recovery()`)

is_superuser.description: Whether the configured user has superuser privileges

last_archived_time.description: The time that a WAL was most recently archived by PostgreSQL (in ISO 8601 in the local timezone of the server)

last_archived_wal.description: The WAL segment which was most recently archived by PostgreSQL

last_failed_time.description: The time of the most recent WAL archive failure on the PostgreSQL server (in ISO 8601 in the local timezone of the server)

last_failed_wal.description: The WAL segment which was being archived during the most recent failed WAL archive attempt

max_replication_slots.description: The current value of max_replication_slots on the PostgreSQL server

max_wal_senders.description: The current value of max_wal_senders on the PostgreSQL server

pg_receivexlog_compatible.description: Whether the pg_receivewal binary used by Barman is compatible with the PostgreSQL server

pg_receivexlog_installed.description: Whether the pg_receivewal binary is installed and available to Barman

pg_receivexlog_path.description: Path to the pg_receivewal binary used by Barman

pg_receivexlog_supports_slots.description: Whether the pg_receivewal binary available to Barman supports replication slots

pg_receivexlog_synchronous.description: Whether synchronous replication will be used by pg_receivewal for this PostgreSQL server

pg_receivexlog_version.description: The version of the pg_receivewal binary used by Barman

postgresql_systemid.description: The system identifier of the PostgreSQL server

replication_slot_support.description: Whether the PostgreSQL server supports replication slots

server_txt_version.description: The version of the PostgreSQL server as human-readable text

stats_reset.description: The time at which statistics were last reset for this PostgreSQL server (in ISO 8601 format in UTC)

streaming.description: Whether the streaming_conninfo connection is currently streaming

streaming_supported.description: Whether streaming replication is supported by the PostgreSQL server

streaming_systemid.description: The systemid returned by calling IDENTIFY_SYSTEM using the streaming_conninfo connection

synchronous_standby_names.description: The current value of synchronous_standby_names on the PostgreSQL server

items.description: Name of a standby server which can support synchronous replication

timeline.description: The current timeline of the PostgreSQL server

wal_compression.description: The current value of wal_compression on the PostgreSQL server

wal_keep_size.description: The current value of wal_keep_size on the PostgreSQL server

wal_level.description: The current value of wal_level on the PostgreSQL server

xlog_segment_size.description: The current WAL segment size in bytes as reported by the PostgreSQL server

xlogpos.description: The current WAL flush location returned by the streaming_conninfo connection

barman_ver.description: Version of Barman which generated the diagnose output

kernel_ver.description: Information about the OS kernel on which Barman server is running

python_ver.description: Version of Python used by Barman server

release.description: Information about the specific OS release on which Barman server is running

rsync_ver.description: Version of Rsync used by Barman server

ssh_ver.description: Version of ssh used by Barman server

timestamp.description: The system time of the Barman server (in ISO 8601 format in the local timezone of the server)

Tablespace.description: A single tablespace represented by an ordered array. The first item MUST be a string containing the name of the tablespace. The second item MUST be a number representing the tablespace OID. The third item MUST be a string containing the path to the tablespace on the PostgreSQL server.

last_archived_wal_per_timeline.description: Details of the most recently archived WAL on the Barman server keyed by timeline.
